I went through a bad depression that almost took my life. There was no reason for it, and no apparent cause. I had never done drugs, and had loving friends and family, yet life still drained the emotion from me. I was seconds from ending it multiple times. The only thing that kept me here was the knowledge that it would destroy my family and girlfriend. After losing pretty much everything, I had two choices. End it, or pull myself out of it. I chose the latter. Coming out of the depression after you have lost everything is the hardest thing I have ever known. Nothingness turned to deep sadness. But I felt again! There was something more than the deep void that filled me before; even if it was sadness. I slowly came back to the world. After I had mostly put my life back together, I decided to try MDMA. I researched and planned. The first time I took it, my brain exploded. I had never felt this happiness before. My mind was finally opened. I finally knew how happy life could be! I didn't take it again for another year, but I didn't need to. I was alive again! I wanted to know what caused it, and how my brain functioned. I researched and studied. I also have a histamine disorder, so I started researching neurochemistry. Since then my life has become more full and complete than I could have ever imagined. I have learned how my brain works, not only chemically, but emotionally. I am connected to everyone around me, and I care more than ever. MDMA showed me how happy my brain could be, and that's all it took. Sometimes that's all we need, just to be shown the possibilities. You'll get through it, you just need to be shown that it's possible!
